label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is alert-TP. The sink writes 'out' to the HTML response writer without encoding. 'out' is derived from 'trusted' (attribute) or 'param' (parameter) via a ternary operator. Since 'param' originates from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') (user input) and serves as the fallback when 'trusted' is null, attacker-controlled data reaches the HTML sink on the common execution path. No HTML encoding or sanitization is applied to 'out'.

evidence.note: User input captured via request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest") assigned to param
Variable out resolves to param if trusted is null, propagating user input
Unsanitized out printed to response.getWriter() in HTML context
